target_customer: Companies with large support, sales and operations workloads such as eToro, Payoneer and Just Eat
problem: Teams spend headcount on repetitive support and back office tasks that AI agents could complete.
business_model: Usage credits (1 cent per credit) plus Pro plans from 1,500 USD per month

founders.name: Ohad Navon
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he launched a support chatbot at Roundforest and graduated at 19; institution not named.

founders.name: Nadav Zamir
previous_startups: Galigu (VR search engine, CTO and co-founder)

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM based agent orchestration with integrations was feasible for a small team in 2023 but reliability was hard.

defensibility.rationale: Wrapper style agent products were easy to copy, with moats limited to integrations and customer workflows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not verified in sources found; support vendors and model providers shipped agent features broadly after 2023.

market_need_then: The YC page cites support teams replaced by AI agents; no dated third party demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Operates on minded.com; a directory says it was formerly AgentsForce and Octo AI (unverified). YC page also links an Octo launch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions against chatbots: completes tasks rather than giving instructions

rebrands.why: Not stated; sourced only from a directory and the YC launch link.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found; plain English name that is hard to search.

pivots.why: Not stated in sources; the YC launch post for Octo and the new tagline indicate the shift.

outcome_analysis: Minded is active with a two person team on YC. Its site claims 1.2M tasks a month and enterprise logos such as eToro and Just Eat, which hints at traction, but no funding round is verified and no outcome yet exists. It moved from support agents to a broad agent platform.
notes: CB Insights lists a 500K convertible note in Jan 2023 (one aggregator, unverified, predates the S23 batch); not recorded as a round. Competitor searches returned only 2026 articles, so list is empty. Team size 2 is from YC and may be stale.
